messages:
Olivia: quick loop-in  small PR to standardize 'realtime' vs 'real-time' and 'latency SLO' wording across quickstarts and the style guide. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/933
Marcus: good catch. product copy currently uses 'real-time' in tutorials but consoles show 'realtime' labels. we should pick one.
Zoe: my vote: use 'real-time' in prose (hyphenated) and keep telemetry/metric names as 'realtime' (no hyphen) when that's the canonical metric ID. add glossary alias.
Harper: agree with Zoe. also prefer 'latency SLO' in docs for expected behavior and 'latency SLA' only when referring to contractual guarantees. small note in the style page will help.
Olivia: proposed rule added to PR description: "Prose: use 'real-time' (hyphen); metric IDs and config keys keep 'realtime' to match telemetry. Use 'latency SLO' in docs; reserve 'SLA' for contract language."
Marcus: can we add a one-line example mapping in the migration doc? e.g., `metric_id: realtime_p95` -> "Display: Real-time P95". helps PMs.
Zoe: I'll add that snippet. also filing issue #1203 to add glossary anchors for 'real-time'/'realtime' and 'latency SLO' so search surfaces both.
style-bot: reminder: update docs/glossary.yml with crossrefs to metric IDs to improve search. Issue created: #1203.
Harper: tiny nit: change tutorial header from "Real time inference" to "Real-time inference" in three places. I'll push a one-line patch after this merges.
Olivia: cool, added follow-up note "normalize metric IDs if necessary (separate infra PR)". moving to reviewers. thanks :sparkles:
